items.officialExcerpt: It is the Board's decision, pursuant to 41 U.S.C. §§ 7105(e), 7108(b), and the parties' stipulation and agreement, that the appeal is sustained. In the nature of a consent judgment, the Board makes a monetary award to appellant in the amount of $114,311.67.
items.practitionerPrompt: Consent judgments are a practical off-ramp. Use them when exposure is clear and the negotiated number is better than continued litigation.
